title: Assign public Route and Gate operators with complementary diagnostics
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. For the selected two-person Crew, assign one Route Operator and one Gate Operator with explicit server-seeded RNG. Operator assignment is public; Route Operator privately sees only safe/corrupted route diagnostics and Gate Operator sees only safe/corrupted gate diagnostics for the current incident. Export assignOperatorsV1 and typed private diagnostic helpers. All alignments use identical controls and diagnostics; Static advantage is existing ally knowledge and choice, never an extra Sabotage button.
acceptance: Exactly one of each operator is assigned to the selected Crew, reproducibly with an explicit next RNG.
Private diagnostic fixtures reveal only the recipient own safe/corrupt axis and never the other operator choice/axis or role.
Public assignment contains member/operator identities and semantic incident reference without hidden matrix diagnostics.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
